description: This source file defines the InfoField class, part of the MigraDoc library, used to reference document info fields (such as title, author, etc.) in document generation. It includes properties, methods for validation, serialization, and cloning, and maintains internal nullable values for its properties.

classes.name: InfoField
classes.description: Represents a reference to a document info field in MigraDoc, with capabilities for validation, cloning, and serialization.

classes.name: InfoFieldValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for InfoField, specifically the 'Name' property.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the InfoField instance.

methods.name: IsValidName
methods.description: Checks if the provided name is a valid InfoFieldType name.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the InfoField into DDL string format.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Indicates whether the InfoField instance is null; always returns false.
